author: GamingBolt
description:
Project Helix has begun to step into the light, and the glimpses of it that we’ve been given point to a console that’s going to take an interesting approach to player agency and integration of multiple devices and platforms into a single device. Is it ambitious? Hell, yeah. Do those ambitions come with trade-offs? Sadly yes.

Join us as we take a look at everything we know about XBOX’s upcoming powerhouse, and examine the things we don’t as the journey to the next generation of consoles enters a new phase of tantalizing reveals and rapidly spreading rumors. We’ve cut through the noise so you don’t have to, and it was a job made quite fun thanks to all the exciting things that XBOX is bringing to Project Helix.
title: Xbox Helix - EVERYTHING We Know So Far

author: GamingBolt
description:
It's that time of the year again. The time when we let hype take the wheel, and where major publishers put on a show, both for our entertainment and the sake of our gaming calendar. Following State of Play, it's the Summer of Gaming with one major showcase after another, starting with the Summer Game Fest showcase on June 5th. 

It's followed by the Future Games Show Summer Showcase on June 6th and a double feature on June 7th with the Xbox Games Showcase and PC Gaming Show. There's also the possibility of a new Nintendo Direct to outline what's coming this year (and potentially beyond), but here are our picks for some of the biggest announcements that you could see, and it all begins with the return of a beloved franchise.
title: 30 Biggest Game Announcements Expected To Drop This Week
